title: Git Forge Exit Drill
summary: Test a GitHub move before your team cuts over.
user: A small team considering a move from GitHub who wants a tested answer to whether repositories, pull-request history, releases, issues, and build provenance will survive.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that inventories an authorized GitHub export or API repository, creates a local encrypted evidence archive, maps artifacts to GitLab, Gitea, or Forgejo, and emits a migration drill checklist.
success_measure: For 10 migrated repositories, teams identify all unsupported or unexported critical artifacts before cutover, and complete a restore drill in under two hours.
constraints: Use only user-authorized API scopes or exports.
Preserve third-party licenses and issue author attribution.
